assertions.description: BaseAudioContext.prototype exposes renderQuantumSize (the readable half of the feature).
Without a hint, renderQuantumSize reads the classic 128 on supporting engines.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof BaseAudioContext === 'undefined' || !('renderQuantumSize' in BaseAudioContext.prototype)) return false; const c = new OfflineAudioContext({ numberOfChannels: 1, length: 128, sampleRate: 48000 }); return c.renderQuantumSize === 128; })()

assertions.description: An integer renderSizeHint of 256 produces a context whose renderQuantumSize reflects the request (UA may adjust, but must not silently ignore on supporting engines).
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof BaseAudioContext === 'undefined' || !('renderQuantumSize' in BaseAudioContext.prototype)) return false; const c = new OfflineAudioContext({ numberOfChannels: 1, length: 256, sampleRate: 48000, renderSizeHint: 256 }); return c.renderQuantumSize !== 128; })()

assertions.description: The block length an AudioWorkletProcessor receives in process() equals the context's renderQuantumSize — the two surfaces must agree.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ const src = 'class M extends AudioWorkletProcessor { constructor(){ super(); this.s = false; } process(i,o){ if (!this.s) { this.s = true; this.port.postMessage(o[0][0].length); } return false; } } registerProcessor("m", M);'; const opts = { numberOfChannels: 1, length: 24000, sampleRate: 48000 }; if (typeof BaseAudioContext !== 'undefined' && 'renderQuantumSize' in BaseAudioContext.prototype) opts.renderSizeHint = 256; const ctx = new OfflineAudioContext(opts); const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([src], { type: 'application/javascript' })); await ctx.audioWorklet.addModule(url); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); const n = new AudioWorkletNode(ctx, 'm'); n.connect(ctx.destination); const measured = await new Promise((res, rej) => { const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('timeout')), 5000); n.port.onmessage = (e) => { clearTimeout(t); res(e.data); }; ctx.startRendering().catch(rej); }); const prop = ctx.renderQuantumSize; return prop === undefined ? measured === 128 : measured === prop; })()

assertions.description: The "hardware" keyword is a valid hint on supporting engines: construction succeeds and renderQuantumSize reads a positive integer.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof BaseAudioContext === 'undefined' || !('renderQuantumSize' in BaseAudioContext.prototype)) return false; const c = new OfflineAudioContext({ numberOfChannels: 1, length: 128, sampleRate: 48000, renderSizeHint: 'hardware' }); return Number.isInteger(c.renderQuantumSize) && c.renderQuantumSize > 0; })()

assertions.description: Constructing with renderSizeHint on a NON-supporting engine still succeeds (WebIDL ignores unknown members) — the constructor must never throw for the hint, which is why constructor success is not a support probe. Holds in every context.
assertions.test: (()=>{ try { new OfflineAudioContext({ numberOfChannels: 1, length: 128, sampleRate: 48000, renderSizeHint: 256 }); return true; } catch (e) { return false; } })()
